summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a foreign private issuer, furnishing its Q3 2026 interim financial statements and MD&A under cover of Form 6-K. The excerpt consists primarily of XBRL data tags for fair value hierarchy levels, loan staging (Stage 1/2/3), and securities classifications—none of which relate to a special situation. There are no M&A, tender offer, restructuring, spin-off, or capital return events disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic report equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q, containing only routine financial disclosures for the period ended July 31, 2026.
